learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.evidence: Selected oxygen for where shared water electrons spend more time.
Built water: electron pairs drawn near oxygen, oxygenδ− and hydrogenδ+. AddedO replacing oneH: O–O pair centered. AddedCl: retainedO andCl partners, O–Cl pair slightly shifted toward centralO.
Read explanation referencing prior O–H and currentO/Cl contrast, equalO midpoint, electronegativity3.44versus2.20 and partial-charge attraction between water molecules.
Actual1257x936 dark screenshots inspected for water, mixedO/H, mixedO/Cl and full readable reveal after scroll; charge legend visible.

prediction.reason: Commits to a plausible misconception but gives little basis for oxygen versus hydrogen without chemistry knowledge.
prediction.evidence: Three electron-location options before any attraction comparison.

interaction.reason: Partner replacement offers equal and unequal sharing contrasts.
interaction.evidence: Water nearO, O–O midpoint, O–Cl smaller shift.

payoff.reason: Reveal ties observed shifts to atom attraction and partial charges.

clarity.evidence: δ− slightly negative and electronegativity defined.
